drivingQuestion: How can the shofar be heard when trumpets sound simultaneously?
outcomeNote: The answer is challenged and replaced in the next unit

segments.he: וּשְׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרוֹת מִן הַצְּדָדִים. וּתְרֵי קָלֵי מִי מִשְׁתַּמְעִי? וְהָתַנְיָא: ״זָכוֹר״ וְ״שָׁמוֹר״, בְּדִיבּוּר אֶחָד נֶאֶמְרוּ, מַה שֶּׁאֵין הַפֶּה יְכוֹלָה לְדַבֵּר וְאֵין הָאוֹזֶן יְכוֹלָה לִשְׁמוֹעַ! לְכָךְ מַאֲרִיךְ בְּשׁוֹפָר.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «And» there were «two trumpets,» one «on» each of «the» two «sides» of the person sounding the shofar. The Gemara asks: «But is it» really «possible to» properly «discern two» different «sounds,» that of the shofar and that of the trumpets, at the same time? «Isn’t it taught» in a baraita: The two versions of the fifth of the Ten Commandments, «“Remember» the Shabbat day” (Exodus 20:8) and «“Keep» the Shabbat day” (Deuteronomy 5:12), «were spoken» by God simultaneously «in a single utterance, something that the» human «mouth cannot speak and the» human «ear cannot hear?» This indicates that it is impossible to take in two sounds at once, and so, due to the sound of the trumpets, it should be impossible to hear the blast of the shofar. The Gemara answers: «For this reason» they «would sound a long» blast «with the shofar,» to make it possible to hear the sound of the shofar on its own.
